tool.description: Reformat a list between forms: comma-separated, newline, bulleted, numbered, quoted, space, tab, pipe, json, xml, sql, or custom separators. input_separator controls splitting; output_format controls layout. Optionally sort (alphabetical, length, reverse, shuffle), dedupe, case-transform (lower, upper, title), or prepend prefix/suffix. Items are trimmed and blanks dropped.

input_separator.description: How to split the input. 'auto' (default) detects separators.

custom_input_separator.description: Custom string delimiter to split the input if input_separator is 'custom'.

custom_output_separator.description: Custom string delimiter to join output items if output_format is 'custom'.

prefix.description: Prefix to prepended to each item.

suffix.description: Suffix to appended to each item.
